static.label: Static partition
static.description: equal contiguous tile ranges, fixed before rendering

dynamic.label: Fixed dynamic
dynamic.description: one tile per assignment, handed out on demand

adaptive.label: Adaptive batching
adaptive.description: batch size from measured worker throughput

alignment: Each run starts at t = 0 on one real-time axis. The runs are separate executions (median-time block of each policy), not simultaneous.
